broker_note: Broker name is taken from the task description; the source files themselves do not contain broker metadata.

source.format: MetaTrader 5 history export, tab-separated, CRLF, header <DATE> <TIME> <OPEN> <HIGH> <LOW> <CLOSE> <TICKVOL> <VOL> <SPREAD> (Daily has no <TIME>)

packages_note: pkg_05_docs_reports_scripts.zip contains this manifest, so its own size/hash cannot be listed here.

time.definition: Bar OPEN time exactly as exported by MT5 (naive broker-server clock, timezone UNVERIFIED). Text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

tick_volume.definition: MT5 tick count in the bar (source <TICKVOL>). A proxy for activity; NOT traded volume.

real_volume.definition: Source <VOL>. 0 in every row of every file: not provided by the feed. Not real volume; not used by any feature.

spread.definition: Source <SPREAD> in MT5 points. 0 means UNKNOWN/unverified, not a free trade.

spread_known.definition: 1 if spread > 0 else 0 (marks rows whose spread value can be used).

bar_close_time.definition: Nominal bar close time = open time + bar length of this file's timeframe (broker-server clock, unverified timezone). All features in the row are available at or after this instant.

server_hour.definition: Hour (0-23) of the bar open time on the broker-server clock (timezone unverified).

server_minute.definition: Minute of the bar open time on the broker-server clock.

dow.definition: Day of week of the bar open time, Monday=0 ... Friday=4 (no weekend bars exist).

session_asia.definition: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [1,10). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.

session_london.definition: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [10,19). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.

session_ny.definition: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [15,24). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.

session_london_ny_overlap.definition: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [15,19). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.

close_pos.definition: (close - low) / range; 0 = closed at low, 1 = at high; NaN if range==0.

gap_open.definition: open - previous bar close (price units). Large values appear after session breaks / weekends.

ret_3.definition: close / close 3 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).

ret_5.definition: close / close 5 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).

ret_10.definition: close / close 10 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).

ret_20.definition: close / close 20 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).

tr.definition: True Range = max(high-low, |high-prev close|, |low-prev close|); NaN on the first bar.

atr_14.definition: Wilder ATR(14): EWM alpha=1/14, seeded by first TR, NaN until 14 TR values exist.

atr_ratio.definition: ATR14 / ATR50: short- vs long-term volatility regime (>1 expanding).

tr_atr_prev.definition: TR / ATR14 of the previous bar (bar size relative to volatility known before the bar).

rv_20.definition: Rolling population std of log_ret_1 over 20 bars (realised volatility).

rv_50.definition: Rolling population std of log_ret_1 over 50 bars (realised volatility).

ema_20.definition: EMA(20) of close, adjust=False, NaN until 20 bars exist (the first 19 rows are warm-up).

ema_50.definition: EMA(50) of close, adjust=False, NaN until 50 bars exist (the first 49 rows are warm-up).

ema_200.definition: EMA(200) of close, adjust=False, NaN until 200 bars exist (the first 199 rows are warm-up).

ema_stack.definition: +1 if EMA20>EMA50>EMA200, -1 if EMA20<EMA50<EMA200, else 0 (also 0 while EMA200 is warming up).

prev_high_20.definition: Highest high of the 20 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).

prev_low_20.definition: Lowest low of the 20 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).

dist_prev_high_20_atr.definition: (prev_high_20 - close) / ATR14 (positive = price below that high).

dist_prev_low_20_atr.definition: (close - prev_low_20) / ATR14 (positive = price above that low).

donchian_pos_20.definition: (close - prev_low_20) / (prev_high_20 - prev_low_20); outside [0,1] when price is beyond the range.

prev_high_50.definition: Highest high of the 50 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).

prev_low_50.definition: Lowest low of the 50 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).

dist_prev_high_50_atr.definition: (prev_high_50 - close) / ATR14 (positive = price below that high).

dist_prev_low_50_atr.definition: (close - prev_low_50) / ATR14 (positive = price above that low).

donchian_pos_50.definition: (close - prev_low_50) / (prev_high_50 - prev_low_50); outside [0,1] when price is beyond the range.

prev_high_100.definition: Highest high of the 100 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).

prev_low_100.definition: Lowest low of the 100 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).

dist_prev_high_100_atr.definition: (prev_high_100 - close) / ATR14 (positive = price below that high).

dist_prev_low_100_atr.definition: (close - prev_low_100) / ATR14 (positive = price above that low).

donchian_pos_100.definition: (close - prev_low_100) / (prev_high_100 - prev_low_100); outside [0,1] when price is beyond the range.

brk_high_20.definition: 1 if close > prev_high_20 (close-based breakout of the previous 20-bar high).

tv_sma_20.definition: SMA(20) of tick_volume (tick count; NOT traded volume).

tv_z_50.definition: z-score of tick_volume over 50 bars (population std).

tv_per_range.definition: tick_volume / bar range (ticks per price unit); NaN if range==0.

streak.definition: Signed run length of consecutive closes in the same direction vs the prior close (+3 = 3 higher closes in a row).

prev_day_high.definition: High of the previous trading DAY (server calendar date, fully closed before this bar).

prev_day_low.definition: Low of the previous trading day.

prev_day_close.definition: Close of the previous trading day.

prev_week_high.definition: High of the previous ISO week (fully closed).

prev_week_low.definition: Low of the previous ISO week.

day_open.definition: Open of the first bar of the current server-calendar day.

week_open.definition: Open of the first bar of the current ISO week.

day_high_so_far.definition: Highest high of the current day up to and including this bar.

day_low_so_far.definition: Lowest low of the current day up to and including this bar.

dist_round_50_atr.definition: (close - nearest multiple of 50) / ATR14 (psychological level distance, signed).

dist_round_100_atr.definition: (close - nearest multiple of 100) / ATR14 (psychological level distance, signed).

swing_high_confirmed.definition: EVENT (1 at the confirmation bar). A swing high at bar i exists if high[i] > max(high[i-5..i-1]) and high[i] >= max(high[i+1..i+5]). It is only flagged at bar i+5 (all 5 confirmation candles closed). The swing bar itself is i = t-5.

swing_low_confirmed.definition: EVENT. Mirror of swing_high_confirmed: low[i] < min(low[i-5..i-1]) and low[i] <= min(low[i+1..i+5]), flagged at bar i+5.

trend_state.definition: Market-structure state after the latest break: +1 bullish (last break was upward), -1 bearish, 0 before the first break.

bos_bull.definition: EVENT. Bar CLOSES above the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing high while trend_state >= 0 (continuation; the very first break from state 0 is also labelled BOS). Each swing level can be broken once.

bos_bear.definition: EVENT. Bar closes below the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing low while trend_state <= 0.

choch_bull.definition: EVENT. Bar closes above the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing high while trend_state == -1 (first break against a bearish structure = Change of Character).

choch_bear.definition: EVENT. Bar closes below the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing low while trend_state == +1.

struct_last_event.definition: Carry-forward code of the latest structure event: 0 none, 1 BOS bull, 2 BOS bear, 3 CHOCH bull, 4 CHOCH bear.

bsl_sweep.definition: EVENT. Buy-side liquidity sweep: bar high exceeds at least one active (confirmed, unbroken, age<=500) swing-high pool but the bar CLOSES at or below that level. Each pool is consumed on first excursion (swept or broken).

ssl_sweep.definition: EVENT. Sell-side liquidity sweep: bar low goes below an active swing-low pool but the bar closes at or above it.

bsl_sweep_eq.definition: 1 if a swept buy-side pool was part of an equal-highs cluster.

ssl_sweep_eq.definition: 1 if a swept sell-side pool was part of an equal-lows cluster.

eqh_formed.definition: EVENT. A newly confirmed swing high lies within 0.1 x ATR14 (at confirmation) of an active unswept swing high = Equal Highs.

eql_formed.definition: EVENT. A newly confirmed swing low within 0.1 x ATR14 of an active unswept swing low = Equal Lows.

pd_valid.definition: 1 if both last_swing_high and last_swing_low exist and last_swing_high > last_swing_low.

pd_zone.definition: +1 premium (pd_pos > 0.55), -1 discount (pd_pos < 0.45), 0 equilibrium band or pd_valid==0.

bsl_n_active.definition: Number of active unswept swing-high pools (max 20).

ssl_n_active.definition: Number of active unswept swing-low pools (max 20).

last_swing_high.definition: Level of the most recent CONFIRMED swing high (carried forward; NaN before the first one). Remains after being broken until a newer swing high is confirmed.

last_swing_low.definition: Level of the most recent confirmed swing low (carried forward).

bars_since_swing_high.definition: t - index of the swing candle (not of its confirmation) of last_swing_high.

bars_since_swing_low.definition: t - index of the swing candle of last_swing_low.

struct_break_level.definition: Price level broken at this bar's BOS/CHOCH (NaN when no break).

bars_since_struct_event.definition: Bars since the latest BOS/CHOCH (NaN before the first).

bsl_sweep_depth_atr.definition: (bar high - outermost swept swing-high level) / ATR14 at a bsl_sweep bar, else NaN.

ssl_sweep_depth_atr.definition: (outermost swept swing-low level - bar low) / ATR14 at an ssl_sweep bar, else NaN.

dist_bsl_atr.definition: (lowest active swing-high pool - close) / ATR14: distance to the nearest buy-side liquidity above price (always >= 0 by construction).

dist_ssl_atr.definition: (close - highest active swing-low pool) / ATR14: distance to the nearest sell-side liquidity below price.

dist_eqh_atr.definition: (nearest active equal-highs pool - close) / ATR14; NaN if none.

dist_eql_atr.definition: (close - nearest active equal-lows pool) / ATR14; NaN if none.

pd_pos.definition: (close - last_swing_low) / (last_swing_high - last_swing_low) when pd_valid; <0 or >1 means price is outside the last confirmed range.

disp_strength_atr.definition: range / ATR14[t-1] for every bar (displacement is the subset exceeding the threshold).

disp_dir.definition: Displacement candle: +1/-1 if range >= 1.5 x ATR14[t-1] AND |body|/range >= 0.6 (sign = candle direction), else 0.

fvg_bull_formed.definition: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bullish FVG: at bar t, low[t] > high[t-2]; zone = [high[t-2], low[t]]; created at close of t only if size >= 0.1 x ATR14[t]. Touch: a later bar's range overlaps the zone (low <= top). Invalidated: a later bar CLOSES below the zone bottom. Expired after 300 bars. Max 15 active zones (oldest dropped).

fvg_bull_n_active.definition: Active (not invalidated/expired) fvg_bull zones after processing this bar.

fvg_bull_touched_now.definition: 1 if this bar touched at least one fvg_bull zone that existed BEFORE this bar.

fvg_bull_invalidated_now.definition: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one fvg_bull zone.

fvg_bull_in_zone.definition: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active fvg_bull zone.

fvg_bull_top.definition: Top price of the nearest active fvg_bull zone (NaN if none).

fvg_bull_bottom.definition: Bottom price of the nearest active fvg_bull zone.

fvg_bull_dist_atr.definition: Distance from close to the nearest active fvg_bull zone edge facing price (zone is below price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

fvg_bull_age.definition: Bars since the nearest active fvg_bull zone was created.

fvg_bull_touches.definition: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active fvg_bull zone since creation.

fvg_bear_formed.definition: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bearish FVG: high[t] < low[t-2]; zone = [high[t], low[t-2]]; same size filter. Touch: range overlaps zone (high >= bottom). Invalidated: a later bar CLOSES above the zone top. Expired after 300 bars.

fvg_bear_n_active.definition: Active (not invalidated/expired) fvg_bear zones after processing this bar.

fvg_bear_touched_now.definition: 1 if this bar touched at least one fvg_bear zone that existed BEFORE this bar.

fvg_bear_invalidated_now.definition: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one fvg_bear zone.

fvg_bear_in_zone.definition: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active fvg_bear zone.

fvg_bear_top.definition: Top price of the nearest active fvg_bear zone (NaN if none).

fvg_bear_bottom.definition: Bottom price of the nearest active fvg_bear zone.

fvg_bear_dist_atr.definition: Distance from close to the nearest active fvg_bear zone edge facing price (zone is above price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

fvg_bear_age.definition: Bars since the nearest active fvg_bear zone was created.

fvg_bear_touches.definition: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active fvg_bear zone since creation.

ob_bull_formed.definition: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bullish Order Block (HEURISTIC): when a bullish BOS/CHOCH closes at bar t, take the last bearish candle (close<open) within 15 bars before t; zone = its full range [low, high]; created only if a bullish displacement candle lies between that candle and t. Touch: later range overlaps zone. Invalidated: later CLOSE below zone low. Expired after 300 bars. Max 10 active.

ob_bull_n_active.definition: Active (not invalidated/expired) ob_bull zones after processing this bar.

ob_bull_touched_now.definition: 1 if this bar touched at least one ob_bull zone that existed BEFORE this bar.

ob_bull_invalidated_now.definition: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one ob_bull zone.

ob_bull_in_zone.definition: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active ob_bull zone.

ob_bull_top.definition: Top price of the nearest active ob_bull zone (NaN if none).

ob_bull_bottom.definition: Bottom price of the nearest active ob_bull zone.

ob_bull_dist_atr.definition: Distance from close to the nearest active ob_bull zone edge facing price (zone is below price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

ob_bull_age.definition: Bars since the nearest active ob_bull zone was created.

ob_bull_touches.definition: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active ob_bull zone since creation.

ob_bear_formed.definition: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bearish Order Block (HEURISTIC): at a bearish BOS/CHOCH take the last bullish candle within 15 bars; zone = its range; requires a bearish displacement candle in the leg. Invalidated: later CLOSE above zone high.

ob_bear_n_active.definition: Active (not invalidated/expired) ob_bear zones after processing this bar.

ob_bear_touched_now.definition: 1 if this bar touched at least one ob_bear zone that existed BEFORE this bar.

ob_bear_invalidated_now.definition: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one ob_bear zone.

ob_bear_in_zone.definition: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active ob_bear zone.

ob_bear_top.definition: Top price of the nearest active ob_bear zone (NaN if none).

ob_bear_bottom.definition: Bottom price of the nearest active ob_bear zone.

ob_bear_dist_atr.definition: Distance from close to the nearest active ob_bear zone edge facing price (zone is above price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

ob_bear_age.definition: Bars since the nearest active ob_bear zone was created.

ob_bear_touches.definition: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active ob_bear zone since creation.

fvg_bull_size_atr.definition: At a bullish-FVG formation bar: gap size / ATR14; else NaN.

fvg_bear_size_atr.definition: At a bearish-FVG formation bar: gap size / ATR14; else NaN.

m15_bar_time.definition: Open time of the M15 candle that was the latest FULLY CLOSED M15 candle at the lower-TF row's close. Empty until the first M15 candle has closed.

m15_age_min.definition: Minutes between that M15 candle's nominal close and the lower-TF row's close (0 = it closed at the same instant; large after weekends/breaks).

m15_close.definition: 'close' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Bar close.

m15_direction.definition: 'direction' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: +1 bullish (close>open), -1 bearish, 0 doji.

m15_atr_14.definition: 'atr_14' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Wilder ATR(14): EWM alpha=1/14, seeded by first TR, NaN until 14 TR values exist.

m15_rsi_14.definition: 'rsi_14' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Wilder RSI(14).

m15_dist_ema_50_atr.definition: 'dist_ema_50_atr' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: (close - EMA50) / ATR14 (signed, ATR units).

m15_ema_stack.definition: 'ema_stack' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: +1 if EMA20>EMA50>EMA200, -1 if EMA20<EMA50<EMA200, else 0 (also 0 while EMA200 is warming up).

m15_macd_hist_atr.definition: 'macd_hist_atr' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: MACD histogram / ATR14.

m15_trend_state.definition: 'trend_state' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Market-structure state after the latest break: +1 bullish (last break was upward), -1 bearish, 0 before the first break.

m15_struct_last_event.definition: 'struct_last_event' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Carry-forward code of the latest structure event: 0 none, 1 BOS bull, 2 BOS bear, 3 CHOCH bull, 4 CHOCH bear.

m15_pd_pos.definition: 'pd_pos' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: (close - last_swing_low) / (last_swing_high - last_swing_low) when pd_valid; <0 or >1 means price is outside the last confirmed range.

m15_last_swing_high.definition: 'last_swing_high' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Level of the most recent CONFIRMED swing high (carried forward; NaN before the first one). Remains after being broken until a newer swing high is confirmed.

m15_last_swing_low.definition: 'last_swing_low' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Level of the most recent confirmed swing low (carried forward).

m15_fvg_bull_dist_atr.definition: 'fvg_bull_dist_atr' of the latest fully closed M15 candle. Original definition: Distance from close to the nearest active fvg_bull zone edge facing price (zone is below price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

h4_direction.definition: 'direction' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: +1 bullish (close>open), -1 bearish, 0 doji.

h4_atr_14.definition: 'atr_14' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Wilder ATR(14): EWM alpha=1/14, seeded by first TR, NaN until 14 TR values exist.

h4_rsi_14.definition: 'rsi_14' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Wilder RSI(14).

h4_dist_ema_50_atr.definition: 'dist_ema_50_atr' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: (close - EMA50) / ATR14 (signed, ATR units).

h4_ema_stack.definition: 'ema_stack' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: +1 if EMA20>EMA50>EMA200, -1 if EMA20<EMA50<EMA200, else 0 (also 0 while EMA200 is warming up).

h4_macd_hist_atr.definition: 'macd_hist_atr' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: MACD histogram / ATR14.

h4_trend_state.definition: 'trend_state' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Market-structure state after the latest break: +1 bullish (last break was upward), -1 bearish, 0 before the first break.

h4_struct_last_event.definition: 'struct_last_event' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Carry-forward code of the latest structure event: 0 none, 1 BOS bull, 2 BOS bear, 3 CHOCH bull, 4 CHOCH bear.

h4_pd_pos.definition: 'pd_pos' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: (close - last_swing_low) / (last_swing_high - last_swing_low) when pd_valid; <0 or >1 means price is outside the last confirmed range.

h4_last_swing_high.definition: 'last_swing_high' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Level of the most recent CONFIRMED swing high (carried forward; NaN before the first one). Remains after being broken until a newer swing high is confirmed.

h4_last_swing_low.definition: 'last_swing_low' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Level of the most recent confirmed swing low (carried forward).

h4_fvg_bull_dist_atr.definition: 'fvg_bull_dist_atr' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Distance from close to the nearest active fvg_bull zone edge facing price (zone is below price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

h4_fvg_bear_dist_atr.definition: 'fvg_bear_dist_atr' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Distance from close to the nearest active fvg_bear zone edge facing price (zone is above price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

h4_ob_bull_dist_atr.definition: 'ob_bull_dist_atr' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Distance from close to the nearest active ob_bull zone edge facing price (zone is below price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

h4_ob_bear_dist_atr.definition: 'ob_bear_dist_atr' of the latest fully closed H4 candle. Original definition: Distance from close to the nearest active ob_bear zone edge facing price (zone is above price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.

d1_bar_time.definition: Open time of the Daily candle that was the latest FULLY CLOSED Daily candle at the lower-TF row's close. Empty until the first Daily candle has closed.

d1_age_min.definition: Minutes between that Daily candle's nominal close and the lower-TF row's close (0 = it closed at the same instant; large after weekends/breaks).

technical_feature_definitions.bar_close_time: Nominal bar close time = open time + bar length of this file's timeframe (broker-server clock, unverified timezone). All features in the row are available at or after this instant.
technical_feature_definitions.server_hour: Hour (0-23) of the bar open time on the broker-server clock (timezone unverified).
technical_feature_definitions.server_minute: Minute of the bar open time on the broker-server clock.
technical_feature_definitions.dow: Day of week of the bar open time, Monday=0 ... Friday=4 (no weekend bars exist).
technical_feature_definitions.session_asia: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [1,10). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.
technical_feature_definitions.session_london: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [10,19). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.
technical_feature_definitions.session_ny: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [15,24). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.
technical_feature_definitions.session_london_ny_overlap: ASSUMPTION-BASED flag: 1 if server_hour in [15,19). Fixed server-clock window; the broker server timezone is unverified, so this is an approximation of the market session, not a verified session label.
technical_feature_definitions.close_pos: (close - low) / range; 0 = closed at low, 1 = at high; NaN if range==0.
technical_feature_definitions.gap_open: open - previous bar close (price units). Large values appear after session breaks / weekends.
technical_feature_definitions.ret_3: close / close 3 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).
technical_feature_definitions.ret_5: close / close 5 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).
technical_feature_definitions.ret_10: close / close 10 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).
technical_feature_definitions.ret_20: close / close 20 bars ago - 1 (momentum / rate of change).
technical_feature_definitions.tr: True Range = max(high-low, |high-prev close|, |low-prev close|); NaN on the first bar.
technical_feature_definitions.atr_14: Wilder ATR(14): EWM alpha=1/14, seeded by first TR, NaN until 14 TR values exist.
technical_feature_definitions.atr_ratio: ATR14 / ATR50: short- vs long-term volatility regime (>1 expanding).
technical_feature_definitions.tr_atr_prev: TR / ATR14 of the previous bar (bar size relative to volatility known before the bar).
technical_feature_definitions.rv_20: Rolling population std of log_ret_1 over 20 bars (realised volatility).
technical_feature_definitions.rv_50: Rolling population std of log_ret_1 over 50 bars (realised volatility).
technical_feature_definitions.ema_20: EMA(20) of close, adjust=False, NaN until 20 bars exist (the first 19 rows are warm-up).
technical_feature_definitions.ema_50: EMA(50) of close, adjust=False, NaN until 50 bars exist (the first 49 rows are warm-up).
technical_feature_definitions.ema_200: EMA(200) of close, adjust=False, NaN until 200 bars exist (the first 199 rows are warm-up).
technical_feature_definitions.ema_stack: +1 if EMA20>EMA50>EMA200, -1 if EMA20<EMA50<EMA200, else 0 (also 0 while EMA200 is warming up).
technical_feature_definitions.prev_high_20: Highest high of the 20 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).
technical_feature_definitions.prev_low_20: Lowest low of the 20 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).
technical_feature_definitions.dist_prev_high_20_atr: (prev_high_20 - close) / ATR14 (positive = price below that high).
technical_feature_definitions.dist_prev_low_20_atr: (close - prev_low_20) / ATR14 (positive = price above that low).
technical_feature_definitions.donchian_pos_20: (close - prev_low_20) / (prev_high_20 - prev_low_20); outside [0,1] when price is beyond the range.
technical_feature_definitions.prev_high_50: Highest high of the 50 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).
technical_feature_definitions.prev_low_50: Lowest low of the 50 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).
technical_feature_definitions.dist_prev_high_50_atr: (prev_high_50 - close) / ATR14 (positive = price below that high).
technical_feature_definitions.dist_prev_low_50_atr: (close - prev_low_50) / ATR14 (positive = price above that low).
technical_feature_definitions.donchian_pos_50: (close - prev_low_50) / (prev_high_50 - prev_low_50); outside [0,1] when price is beyond the range.
technical_feature_definitions.prev_high_100: Highest high of the 100 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).
technical_feature_definitions.prev_low_100: Lowest low of the 100 bars BEFORE the current bar (current bar excluded).
technical_feature_definitions.dist_prev_high_100_atr: (prev_high_100 - close) / ATR14 (positive = price below that high).
technical_feature_definitions.dist_prev_low_100_atr: (close - prev_low_100) / ATR14 (positive = price above that low).
technical_feature_definitions.donchian_pos_100: (close - prev_low_100) / (prev_high_100 - prev_low_100); outside [0,1] when price is beyond the range.
technical_feature_definitions.brk_high_20: 1 if close > prev_high_20 (close-based breakout of the previous 20-bar high).
technical_feature_definitions.tv_sma_20: SMA(20) of tick_volume (tick count; NOT traded volume).
technical_feature_definitions.tv_z_50: z-score of tick_volume over 50 bars (population std).
technical_feature_definitions.tv_per_range: tick_volume / bar range (ticks per price unit); NaN if range==0.
technical_feature_definitions.streak: Signed run length of consecutive closes in the same direction vs the prior close (+3 = 3 higher closes in a row).
technical_feature_definitions.prev_day_high: High of the previous trading DAY (server calendar date, fully closed before this bar).
technical_feature_definitions.prev_day_low: Low of the previous trading day.
technical_feature_definitions.prev_day_close: Close of the previous trading day.
technical_feature_definitions.prev_week_high: High of the previous ISO week (fully closed).
technical_feature_definitions.prev_week_low: Low of the previous ISO week.
technical_feature_definitions.day_open: Open of the first bar of the current server-calendar day.
technical_feature_definitions.week_open: Open of the first bar of the current ISO week.
technical_feature_definitions.day_high_so_far: Highest high of the current day up to and including this bar.
technical_feature_definitions.day_low_so_far: Lowest low of the current day up to and including this bar.
technical_feature_definitions.dist_round_50_atr: (close - nearest multiple of 50) / ATR14 (psychological level distance, signed).
technical_feature_definitions.dist_round_100_atr: (close - nearest multiple of 100) / ATR14 (psychological level distance, signed).

smc_feature_definitions.swing_high_confirmed: EVENT (1 at the confirmation bar). A swing high at bar i exists if high[i] > max(high[i-5..i-1]) and high[i] >= max(high[i+1..i+5]). It is only flagged at bar i+5 (all 5 confirmation candles closed). The swing bar itself is i = t-5.
smc_feature_definitions.swing_low_confirmed: EVENT. Mirror of swing_high_confirmed: low[i] < min(low[i-5..i-1]) and low[i] <= min(low[i+1..i+5]), flagged at bar i+5.
smc_feature_definitions.last_swing_high: Level of the most recent CONFIRMED swing high (carried forward; NaN before the first one). Remains after being broken until a newer swing high is confirmed.
smc_feature_definitions.last_swing_low: Level of the most recent confirmed swing low (carried forward).
smc_feature_definitions.bars_since_swing_high: t - index of the swing candle (not of its confirmation) of last_swing_high.
smc_feature_definitions.bars_since_swing_low: t - index of the swing candle of last_swing_low.
smc_feature_definitions.trend_state: Market-structure state after the latest break: +1 bullish (last break was upward), -1 bearish, 0 before the first break.
smc_feature_definitions.bos_bull: EVENT. Bar CLOSES above the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing high while trend_state >= 0 (continuation; the very first break from state 0 is also labelled BOS). Each swing level can be broken once.
smc_feature_definitions.bos_bear: EVENT. Bar closes below the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing low while trend_state <= 0.
smc_feature_definitions.choch_bull: EVENT. Bar closes above the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing high while trend_state == -1 (first break against a bearish structure = Change of Character).
smc_feature_definitions.choch_bear: EVENT. Bar closes below the last confirmed, not-yet-broken swing low while trend_state == +1.
smc_feature_definitions.struct_break_level: Price level broken at this bar's BOS/CHOCH (NaN when no break).
smc_feature_definitions.struct_last_event: Carry-forward code of the latest structure event: 0 none, 1 BOS bull, 2 BOS bear, 3 CHOCH bull, 4 CHOCH bear.
smc_feature_definitions.bars_since_struct_event: Bars since the latest BOS/CHOCH (NaN before the first).
smc_feature_definitions.bsl_sweep: EVENT. Buy-side liquidity sweep: bar high exceeds at least one active (confirmed, unbroken, age<=500) swing-high pool but the bar CLOSES at or below that level. Each pool is consumed on first excursion (swept or broken).
smc_feature_definitions.ssl_sweep: EVENT. Sell-side liquidity sweep: bar low goes below an active swing-low pool but the bar closes at or above it.
smc_feature_definitions.bsl_sweep_eq: 1 if a swept buy-side pool was part of an equal-highs cluster.
smc_feature_definitions.ssl_sweep_eq: 1 if a swept sell-side pool was part of an equal-lows cluster.
smc_feature_definitions.bsl_sweep_depth_atr: (bar high - outermost swept swing-high level) / ATR14 at a bsl_sweep bar, else NaN.
smc_feature_definitions.ssl_sweep_depth_atr: (outermost swept swing-low level - bar low) / ATR14 at an ssl_sweep bar, else NaN.
smc_feature_definitions.bsl_n_active: Number of active unswept swing-high pools (max 20).
smc_feature_definitions.ssl_n_active: Number of active unswept swing-low pools (max 20).
smc_feature_definitions.dist_bsl_atr: (lowest active swing-high pool - close) / ATR14: distance to the nearest buy-side liquidity above price (always >= 0 by construction).
smc_feature_definitions.dist_ssl_atr: (close - highest active swing-low pool) / ATR14: distance to the nearest sell-side liquidity below price.
smc_feature_definitions.eqh_formed: EVENT. A newly confirmed swing high lies within 0.1 x ATR14 (at confirmation) of an active unswept swing high = Equal Highs.
smc_feature_definitions.eql_formed: EVENT. A newly confirmed swing low within 0.1 x ATR14 of an active unswept swing low = Equal Lows.
smc_feature_definitions.dist_eqh_atr: (nearest active equal-highs pool - close) / ATR14; NaN if none.
smc_feature_definitions.dist_eql_atr: (close - nearest active equal-lows pool) / ATR14; NaN if none.
smc_feature_definitions.pd_valid: 1 if both last_swing_high and last_swing_low exist and last_swing_high > last_swing_low.
smc_feature_definitions.pd_pos: (close - last_swing_low) / (last_swing_high - last_swing_low) when pd_valid; <0 or >1 means price is outside the last confirmed range.
smc_feature_definitions.pd_zone: +1 premium (pd_pos > 0.55), -1 discount (pd_pos < 0.45), 0 equilibrium band or pd_valid==0.
smc_feature_definitions.disp_dir: Displacement candle: +1/-1 if range >= 1.5 x ATR14[t-1] AND |body|/range >= 0.6 (sign = candle direction), else 0.
smc_feature_definitions.disp_strength_atr: range / ATR14[t-1] for every bar (displacement is the subset exceeding the threshold).
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_size_atr: At a bullish-FVG formation bar: gap size / ATR14; else NaN.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_size_atr: At a bearish-FVG formation bar: gap size / ATR14; else NaN.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_formed: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bullish FVG: at bar t, low[t] > high[t-2]; zone = [high[t-2], low[t]]; created at close of t only if size >= 0.1 x ATR14[t]. Touch: a later bar's range overlaps the zone (low <= top). Invalidated: a later bar CLOSES below the zone bottom. Expired after 300 bars. Max 15 active zones (oldest dropped).
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_n_active: Active (not invalidated/expired) fvg_bull zones after processing this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_touched_now: 1 if this bar touched at least one fvg_bull zone that existed BEFORE this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_invalidated_now: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one fvg_bull zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_in_zone: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active fvg_bull zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_top: Top price of the nearest active fvg_bull zone (NaN if none).
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_bottom: Bottom price of the nearest active fvg_bull zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_dist_atr: Distance from close to the nearest active fvg_bull zone edge facing price (zone is below price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_age: Bars since the nearest active fvg_bull zone was created.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bull_touches: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active fvg_bull zone since creation.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_formed: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bearish FVG: high[t] < low[t-2]; zone = [high[t], low[t-2]]; same size filter. Touch: range overlaps zone (high >= bottom). Invalidated: a later bar CLOSES above the zone top. Expired after 300 bars.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_n_active: Active (not invalidated/expired) fvg_bear zones after processing this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_touched_now: 1 if this bar touched at least one fvg_bear zone that existed BEFORE this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_invalidated_now: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one fvg_bear zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_in_zone: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active fvg_bear zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_top: Top price of the nearest active fvg_bear zone (NaN if none).
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_bottom: Bottom price of the nearest active fvg_bear zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_dist_atr: Distance from close to the nearest active fvg_bear zone edge facing price (zone is above price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_age: Bars since the nearest active fvg_bear zone was created.
smc_feature_definitions.fvg_bear_touches: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active fvg_bear zone since creation.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_formed: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bullish Order Block (HEURISTIC): when a bullish BOS/CHOCH closes at bar t, take the last bearish candle (close<open) within 15 bars before t; zone = its full range [low, high]; created only if a bullish displacement candle lies between that candle and t. Touch: later range overlaps zone. Invalidated: later CLOSE below zone low. Expired after 300 bars. Max 10 active.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_n_active: Active (not invalidated/expired) ob_bull zones after processing this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_touched_now: 1 if this bar touched at least one ob_bull zone that existed BEFORE this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_invalidated_now: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one ob_bull zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_in_zone: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active ob_bull zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_top: Top price of the nearest active ob_bull zone (NaN if none).
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_bottom: Bottom price of the nearest active ob_bull zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_dist_atr: Distance from close to the nearest active ob_bull zone edge facing price (zone is below price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_age: Bars since the nearest active ob_bull zone was created.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bull_touches: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active ob_bull zone since creation.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_formed: EVENT (1 on the creation bar). Bearish Order Block (HEURISTIC): at a bearish BOS/CHOCH take the last bullish candle within 15 bars; zone = its range; requires a bearish displacement candle in the leg. Invalidated: later CLOSE above zone high.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_n_active: Active (not invalidated/expired) ob_bear zones after processing this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_touched_now: 1 if this bar touched at least one ob_bear zone that existed BEFORE this bar.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_invalidated_now: 1 if this bar invalidated at least one ob_bear zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_in_zone: 1 if close lies inside the nearest active ob_bear zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_top: Top price of the nearest active ob_bear zone (NaN if none).
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_bottom: Bottom price of the nearest active ob_bear zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_dist_atr: Distance from close to the nearest active ob_bear zone edge facing price (zone is above price), / ATR14; 0 if inside; NaN if no active zone.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_age: Bars since the nearest active ob_bear zone was created.
smc_feature_definitions.ob_bear_touches: Number of bars that have touched the nearest active ob_bear zone since creation.

causality_rules.row_timestamp: bar OPEN time; every value in the row is a function of bars <= this bar only (known at open time + bar length).
causality_rules.indicators: rolling/EWM windows only look backwards; previous highs/lows/levels exclude the current bar; ATR-based thresholds for displacement use ATR of the previous bar.
causality_rules.swings: a swing at bar i is published at bar i+5 (all confirmation candles closed); structure breaks use closes beyond confirmed levels only.
causality_rules.zones: FVG/OB are created at the close of the bar that completes them and can only be touched/invalidated by LATER bars.
causality_rules.tests: truncation test (features on a prefix equal the full-run values) + independent brute-force re-derivations; see validation report.

multitimeframe_alignment.method: pandas.merge_asof(direction='backward', allow_exact_matches=True) on nominal close times
multitimeframe_alignment.unfinished_candles: never exposed; an HTF candle appears only on the first lower-TF row whose close is >= the HTF candle's nominal close
multitimeframe_alignment.conservative_note: Nominal close is used even on shortened sessions; this can only delay, never advance, HTF availability.

timestamp_and_timezone.convention: MT5 bar open time on the broker-server clock

empirical_diagnostics.method: per server calendar date, from H1 bars: hour of first/last bar vs. US/EU DST mismatch windows
empirical_diagnostics.interpretation: The daily session end shifts by one hour exactly in the weeks where US and EU daylight-saving differ. That is consistent with a broker server clock that follows EU DST (EET/EEST, UTC+2 winter / UTC+3 summer) while the underlying gold market break follows New York. This is an empirical inference only and is NOT an independent verification of the broker timezone.
empirical_diagnostics.status: UNVERIFIED - timestamps kept exactly as exported

timestamp_and_timezone.consequence: Session flags and hour-of-day features are expressed in server-clock hours only; no UTC conversion was made.

real_volume.note: real_volume is 0 in every row: not exported by the broker feed. It is NOT traded volume and is not used as a feature.

spread_points.note: spread==0 is treated as UNKNOWN/unverified (not a zero transaction cost). MT5 spread is in points; point size is not stated in the files (prices carry 2 decimals).

gaps.interpretation: MT5 creates no bar for an interval without ticks. Missing slots are reported, never filled.

warmup_guidance: Rows before the index above have at least one core indicator (EMA200 etc.) undefined. SMC state (structure, zones, liquidity) also needs burn-in; a conservative practice is to discard at least the first 500 rows of every timeframe before building labels.
verified_facts: All six timeframes were read; no duplicate timestamps, no OHLC violations, no missing values, all timestamps on the timeframe grid (see data_quality_summary).
M15/M30/H1/H4/Daily bars equal the aggregation of the M5 bars (open/high/low/close/tick_volume) for every covered bar (cross_timeframe_consistency_vs_M5).
No candle is missing inside trading sessions; the only gaps are daily breaks, weekends and 17 multi-day holiday gaps (gaps summary).
real_volume == 0 in every row of every file.
Features pass the truncation (no look-ahead) tests and independent re-derivations listed in the validation report.
assumptions: Prices are assumed to be broker BID candles (the MT5 default); the files do not state it.
MT5 spread is in points; a point is assumed to be 0.01 USD only because prices carry 2 decimals. Not verified and NOT used in any feature.
Server timezone is NOT assumed in any computation; session windows are fixed server-hour ranges meant as rough proxies.
SMC parameters (swing 5/5, FVG min 0.10 ATR, displacement 1.5 ATR / body 0.6, equal-level tolerance 0.10 ATR, ...) are a-priori choices, not optimised.
unresolved_issues: Exact historical broker-server timezone and DST rules (empirical pattern is consistent with EET/EEST but unverified).
Meaning of the MT5 spread field per bar (open/last/max) and the point size.
Commission and slippage for the intended trading account are unknown.
No external price source was available, so absolute price accuracy cannot be cross-checked (only internal consistency).
No economic-calendar/news data is included; none was invented.
known_limitations: Raw price-level columns (open/high/low/close, EMAs, Bollinger bands, previous highs/lows, levels, SMC zone prices) are non-stationary (gold traded from ~1,615 to ~5,598 USD in the file). Prefer the ATR-normalised/relative columns for modelling.
Order Blocks are a heuristic interpretation; zones are capped in number and expire after a fixed number of bars, so very old zones are forgotten by design.
Swings need 5 closed bars on each side, so structure information lags price by 5 bars.
Tick volume is broker-specific and not comparable with exchange volume.
Spread==0 rows are unknown; zero-spread share is not uniform across years (see reports).
Only one broker feed; no tick data; no order-book data.
Daily candles and day/week levels use the server calendar date, which in US/EU DST-mismatch weeks is shifted by one hour relative to the New York-based market break.
The data starts on 2020-11-11, so there is no pre-history for indicator warm-up.
